# `atum.cloud-execution/1.14`: ChatGPT plan relay dispatch

This additive R2 version carries 1.13 byte for byte. A `chatgpt-relay.dispatch.response` binds the zero-Proton model grant to one selected owner Mac. The sandbox still receives only the controller broker URL, the opaque turn token and the selected alias. The controller forwards the bounded call over the authenticated device transport; OAuth stays on the Mac. Offline, revoked or disabled relays are terminal and never fall back to Atum billing.
